--- page 9 ---
BRAKES THAT WERE BORN
ON THE TRACK
Look behind the GT’s 19-inch wheels* and you’ll find vented
Brembo® brakes — the same brand found on some of
the most prestigious cars of the last 40 years. They give you
outstanding deceleration performance, corner brake control,
and precise handling in a variety of conditions.†
BREMBO® HIGH-PERFORMANCE BRAKES*
GT’s powerful Brembo® brakes feature signature red, fixed
quad-piston front calipers and dual-piston rear calipers.
Larger overall brake rotors than 2017 Porsche Panamera V6‡
help provide more consistent braking performance.†
BRAKE ASSIST SYSTEM (BAS)
If you slam on your brakes, BAS is designed to sense the urgency and
apply full brake power, which can help shorten your braking distance.†
ELECTRONIC BRAKE-FORCE DISTRIBUTION (EBD)
Based on the vehicle’s weight distribution, EBD helps adjust the balance
of brake power accordingly.†
BRAKE FADE COMPENSATION
It automatically increases hydraulic pressure in the braking system as
the temperatures rise, so the driver does not need to press as hard on
the pedal. This results in a more consistent and confident braking feel.†
†No system, no matter how advanced, can compensate for all driver errors, driving conditions, accidents,
and/or injury. Always drive responsibly. ‡Based on published manufacturer specifications as of
September 2017. *Optional feature available only on certain trims. See kia.com for details. GT2 SHOWN

Just stand near your Stinger with the available
Smart Key in your hand, pocket, or bag and its sensors
are designed to work their magic as described below.
SMART WELCOME

and unfolds the power side mirrors to greet you.
SMART POWER TRUNK*
When you stand near your trunk, it’s designed to automatically
open after three seconds. Close it with a push of a button.
